t: This is the statue of Captain John Smith. Smith was an English soldier, explorer and writer. After a life as a soldier of fortune, he played an important role in founding the colony at Jamestown, Virginia, the first English settlement in North America. He led the Virginia Colony from September 1608 to August 1609, and during his explorations he became the first English explorer to map the Chesapeake Bay area. He was also knighted for his services to the Prince of Transylvania. That is the man the statue shows.
